Neither of the two listed options is correct. Mutations are not always harmful, since many are neutral and some are beneficial, and they don't only occur with radiation, because they also arise from replication errors and chemical mutagens. If I must pick from that list, I'd say "only occur when exposed to radiation" is the less wrong of the two, but I'd still flag it as inaccurate. The accurate completion is "…changes in the nucleotide sequence of DNA."

CONFIDENCE: 80
